note: Alpha Bank's fee information document (last updated 11 August 2025) for its Έξυπνη Αποταμίευση savings account, the everyday account there: its general account services list no fee for keeping the account, only for statements by post, web-banking enrolment (8 euros once) and notifications (1.90), none modelled.
